params.body: A reset that landed mid-write on 11 September 2026 left an empty action file beside the workbench's step 3, and every reader of it has failed since: the gateway answers 500, the daily mirror stopped there. Attachments are now written to a temporary name and renamed into place, as the records already are synced. The empty file on the machine stays as it is; the mirror names it (elixir PR 166) and the record beside it is intact.
params.title: log: an attachment is written whole or not at all
